title: Residential Household Dataset: Occupancy, Water, and Electricity Data
authors: Schaffer, Jensen, Larsen, Marszal-Pomianowska, Rohde, Rubak, Vera-Valdes (2025)
source_timestamp: exclusive end of preceding one-hour interval
occupancy_date: noon-to-noon label based on source timestamp; excluded from measurements
preprocessing: Cumulative index interpolated onto rounded timestamps upstream
Rounded litre indexes differenced to form hourly volumes upstream
Per-building daily minimum hourly volume subtracted upstream
receipt_policy: received_at is actual research archive receipt; historical provider receipt is not published
identity_policy: export building plus UTC interval end; no value or CSV row number in event identity
registry_policy: export building aliases attached to logical series identifiers; physical meter serials are not published
remaining_limits: Published processed volume is not raw water consumption or validated leakage truth
Published preprocessing is retrospective; historical online availability is unknown
No imported questionnaire, income, weather or independent leak labels
Full technical-report PDF was blocked with HTTP 403 during verification; primary processing scripts were inspected instead
Separate diary cohort hourly_data.csv is preserved in the ZIP but not combined with the annual cohort
